title: Fleet and Operations Manager
description:
Company Name: Mustein Private Limited
 Position Title : Fleet and Operations Manager
 Number of Vacancies : 100
 Experience Required : 0 to 2 Years
 Salary : 3.9 LPA to 4.2 LPA
 Job Type : Full-time We are looking for dynamic, execution-focused Fleet and Operations Managers to scale our ground operations. In this role, you will lead hyperlocal last-mile delivery teams, manage cold-chain logistics compliance, and optimize day-to-day delivery metrics. This role is ideal for sharp management graduates or young operational professionals eager to build a career in high-growth quick commerce. 
 Role & responsibilities Fleet and Rider Operations: Onboard, train, manage, and retain a high-performing fleet of delivery executives (riders) for daily hyperlocal delivery operations. Cold-Chain and Food Safety Management: Enforce strict adherence to cold-chain logistics, temperature control, hygienic packaging, and timely delivery protocols tailored for fresh meat and perishable items. Delivery Optimization: Track key operational metrics including SLA compliance, Order Fulfillment Rates, First-Mile/Last-Mile turnaround time, cost per delivery, and order accuracy. Demand and Supply Balancing: Forecast order surges and optimize fleet allocation across dark stores, processing hubs, and seller nodes to ensure seamless coverage. Payouts and Incentives: Supervise rider attendance, cash collection, digital wallet reconciliation, and performance-linked weekly payout structures. Partner Coordination: Collaborate with vendor hubs, dark store leads, and customer support teams to resolve operational bottlenecks and delivery escalations in real-time. Compliance and Safety: Ensure compliance with local traffic, vehicle documentation, rider safety norms, and FSSAI transport safety guidelines. 

 Preferred candidate profile Fleet Management, Logistics Operations, Route Optimization, Vendor Management, Rider Management, SLA Management, Fuel Optimization, GPS Tracking, Supply Chain Operations.Work Locations (Tier-1 and Tier-2 Cities across India): Tier-1 : Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune. North India: Jaipur, Lucknow, Chandigarh, Agra, Kanpur, Ghaziabad, Faridabad, Amritsar, Dehradun, Varanasi. West India: Surat, Indore, Nagpur, Nashik, Bhopal, Vadodara, Rajkot, Aurangabad (Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar). South India: Kochi, Coimbatore, Kozhikode, Madurai, Mysuru, Mangaluru, Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Thiruvananthapuram. East and Central India: Bhubaneswar, Patna, Jamshedpur, Ranchi, Cuttack, Raipur. Educational Qualification: Any Graduate, B.Tech, or BE in Operations, Logistics, Supply Chain, or Business Administration. An MBA in Logistics or Operations is preferred. Experience: 0 to 2 years of relevant experience. Proven track record in managing last-mile delivery fleets within quick-commerce, food delivery, e-commerce, or cold-chain logistics is a plus. Freshers with relevant operational internships are welcome. Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of ground operations, rider hiring or retention strategies, route optimization tools, and hyperlocal operations metrics (SLA, TAT, Cost per Delivery). Soft Skills: Strong leadership skills to manage large, field-level teams and delivery associates. Comfortable working in high-pressure, fast-paced startup environments. Local Advantage: Local language proficiency and familiarity with city geography or routes is a strong advantage.

title: Title Insurance
description:
POSITION SUMMARY Assistant Manager Operations will manage day-to-day US Title Insurance operations, ensuring achievement of quality, productivity, turnaround time, and SLA requirements. The role is responsible for leading high-performing teams, managing operational performance, supporting client requirements and escalations, and driving continuous improvement, process compliance, and operational efficiency. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES – OPERATIONS Manage day-to-day operations, including Title Search and related title products. Ensure achievement of defined quality, productivity, turnaround time, and SLA targets, with proactive action on potential SLA risks. Monitor queues, workloads, volumes, and staffing to ensure timely completion of orders and effective resource utilization. Review daily operational performance and implement corrective actions for identified gaps. Ensure accurate and timely operational reporting and maintain effective process controls. Support implementation and stabilization of new processes, products, clients, and projects. Plan resources based on transaction volumes, business requirements, and forecasted demand. QUALITY & PROCESS MANAGEMENT Ensure adherence to client-specific requirements, SOPs, process guidelines, and applicable compliance standards. Analyze quality trends, recurring errors, audit findings, and rework; implement corrective and preventive actions. Identify process gaps and opportunities for standardization, automation, cost optimization, and productivity improvement. Ensure audit observations are addressed within defined timelines and process documentation is kept current. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance quality, efficiency, and client experience. PEOPLE MANAGEMENT Lead, coach, and mentor team members to achieve individual and operational performance objectives. Manage attendance, staffing, roster/shift planning, and resource utilization. Conduct performance reviews, provide timely feedback, and address performance gaps through structured coaching. Identify training needs and coordinate with Training/Quality teams to close skill gaps. Build a culture of accountability, quality, collaboration, employee engagement, and continuous improvement. Support effective onboarding, nesting, and transition of new hires into production. CLIENT & STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT Act as a key point of contact for day-to-day client communication and operational requirements. Manage client queries and escalations proactively and ensure timely resolution. Participate in client calls and business reviews and provide updates on performance, risks, and action plans. Build strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders. Coordinate with Quality, Training, Workforce Management, Technology, Finance, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth service delivery. REPORTING, COMPLIANCE & RISK MANAGEMENT Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly reports covering productivity, quality, SLA/TAT, volume, capacity, utilization, attendance, backlog, and error trends. Analyze operational data, identify trends and risks, and present actionable improvement plans to management. Ensure adherence to organizational policies, client requirements, process guidelines, and applicable compliance standards. Escalate significant operational, quality, compliance, or client-impacting risks to the appropriate leadership team. JOB REQUIREMENTS Bachelor’s degree from a recognized institution. 6+ years of experience in BPO/ITES operations, preferably with significant experience in US Mortgage/Title Insurance operations. Strong knowledge of US Residential Mortgage Title Search and related Title Insurance products/processes. Experience managing teams in a production environment with defined quality, productivity, and SLA metrics. Experience in client communication, operational reviews, escalation management, process improvement, and root-cause analysis. Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, verbal, and written communication skills. Working knowledge of MS Excel, reporting tools, and operational systems. Willingness to work flexible shifts, including weekends/holidays, based on business requirements; travel may be required.

Key Skills: US Mortgage,Title Search,Searching,Mortgage,Insurance,Title Insurance
